['Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles', 'From molecule_dictionary', 'Join activities on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', "Filter target_dictionary.pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 2C19' and target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606", 'Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', 'Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'Sort by compound_chembl_id', 'Limit 0']
